title: Meta-Frieren: Beyond Single Level Online Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07169v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a two-stage online optimization problem: at each round, a meta-learner first selects an agent-environment pair, then the chosen agent interacts with the environment, and receives a reward. We introduce Meta-Frieren, a general framework for maximizing cumulative reward in this setting. Our analysis yields a simple UCB-style criterion for meta-level selection and recovers prior guarantees as special cases while extending them to broader settings. We instantiate Meta-Frieren with GP-UCB under Bayesian and frequentist assumptions. We also derive, to our knowledge, the first high-probability regret bound for Feel-Good Thompson Sampling, specialize it to finite and parametric function classes, and integrate it into Meta-Frieren. Experiments support our theoretical results and demonstrate that Meta-Frieren can be successfully applied to hyperparameter optimization across multiple model classes.

translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个两阶段在线优化问题：在每一轮中，元学习者首先选择一个智能体-环境对，然后被选中的智能体与环境进行交互并获得奖励。我们提出了Meta-Frieren，一个用于在此设定下最大化累积奖励的通用框架。我们的分析给出了一个简单的UCB风格准则用于元层面的选择，该准则将先前的理论保证作为特例恢复，同时将其扩展到更广泛的设定。我们在贝叶斯和频率派假设下用GP-UCB对Meta-Frieren进行了实例化。此外，据我们所知，我们首次推导了Feel-Good Thompson采样的高概率遗憾界，将其特化到有限函数类和参数化函数类，并将其集成到Meta-Frieren中。实验验证了我们的理论结果，并表明Meta-Frieren可以成功应用于跨多个模型类的超参数优化。
tldr: Meta-Frieren是一个两阶段在线优化的通用框架，通过UCB风格的元层面选择准则最大化累积奖励，统一并扩展了已有理论保证，首次为Feel-Good Thompson采样推导出高概率遗憾界，并可成功应用于跨多个模型类的超参数优化。
en_tdlr: Meta-Frieren is a general two-stage online optimization framework that maximizes cumulative reward via a simple UCB-style meta-level selection criterion, unifies and extends prior guarantees, derives the first high-probability regret bound for Feel-Good Thompson Sampling, and successfully applies to hyperparameter optimization across multiple model classes.
